title: BREAKING: Miguel Diaz Arrested on Felony DWI Charge, Third Offense or More
excerpt: Miguel Diaz was arrested October 25, 2026, by the Laredo Police Department on a third-degree felony charge of driving while intoxicated, third offense or more, and booked into the Webb County Jail.
content:
BREAKING: Miguel Diaz was arrested on October 25, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department and booked into the Webb County Jail, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking record.

Diaz is charged with driving while intoxicated, third offense or more, a third-degree felony. The charge is an allegation, and Diaz is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

No bond amount was listed in the booking record at the time of this report.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
